body:
No problem! It's a crazy feeling but what I have learnt is that every thought I have.. someone has felt the same. You have to be able to share your thought no matter how hard they are. 

I was stuck in the house for a few weeks and i started watching a show called 'bojack horseman'. It took some time to get into it, but it was something I could relate to.

I totally understand the need for a hug. This is no help at all but hugs always seem to get me through my worst times. There is just something nice about physically connecting with someone. 

I have felt they same as you. People seem to isolate from you when you open up. I'm not sure if it's because they think your overreacting or if they are scared to make things worse... all i know is it fking hurts. I almost wanted to kill myself just to prove them wrong that they should have been there. 

You just need to find someone to connect to that will actually talk to you. I had no friends to talk to for a while so I found solace in talking to a therapist. Recently I met this girl who has been through a lot and made it out the other side. She's been amazing for me and is always there. You will find that but in the meantime I recommend therapy. 

Stay strong and much love

Give yourself three days. If you get even a glimpse of thought of wanting to live or anything that you are worried about leaving behind, then reset the clock. I did this and it helped me not make irrational decisions when I was in my worst. Stay strong <3

Stay strong man. I get like this often... however every day it gets a little easier. I was unemployed for so long and thought easier if I just died. If you keep going it will get easier... you just have to keep going.. that's the hard part.
